ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA sub-question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A geography interest group from a certain school went to an uninhabited island in Fujian Province to carry out field investigation activities. Figure A is a contour topographic map of the island, and Figure B is a photo taken by a certain student. Based on this, complete the following question. <image1> When standing at the four places in the figure to observe the island, which location has the largest observed area?

Figure A is a contour topographic map of the island, and Figure B is a photo taken by a certain student. Based on this, complete the following question. <image1> When standing at the four places in the figure to observe the island, which location has the largest observed area?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure A is the contour topographic map of the sea island, and the figure marks four observation points, ①, ②, ③, and ④. ① is located inside the closed contour line in the western part of the island, the surrounding contour lines are relatively dense, and the position is close to a local high point; ② is at a low place near the coast on the eastern side of the island; ③ is at a low place near the coast on the northwestern side of the island; ④ is near the central-southern part of the island, and although it is inside contour lines, it is not inside the highest closed contour circle. Figure B is a sea-surface photo, mainly serving as background explanation for this question. Then reason: On the same sea island, the higher the elevation of the observation point and the closer it is to the mountaintop, the less visual obstruction there is, and the larger the island-surface range that can usually be seen. Among the four places, ① has the relatively highest elevation and is closest to the local mountaintop, so the one with the largest observed area is ①.

<image1>

When standing at the four places in the figure to observe the island, which location has the largest observed area?

method.method_draft: 先从图甲读出四个观测点的位置和等高线分布，判断各点的相对海拔与是否接近山顶。比较可见，①位于西部闭合等高线内侧、等高线密集处，接近局部高点；②、③靠近海岸低处，④不在最高闭合圈内。再用“海拔越高、越接近山顶，观测范围越大”的规则，选出观测面积最大的地点为①。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图甲是该海岛的等高线地形图，图中标出①、②、③、④四个观测点。①位于岛西部的闭合等高线内侧，周围等高线较密集，位置接近局部高点；②在岛东侧靠近海岸的低处；③在岛西北侧靠近海岸的低处；④在岛中南部附近，虽在等高线内，但不在最高的闭合等高线圈内。图乙是海面照片，对本题主要起背景说明作用。再推理：在同一海岛上，观测点海拔越高、越接近山顶，视野遮挡越少，能看到的岛面范围通常越大。四地中①相对海拔最高且最接近局部山顶，因此观测面积最大的是①。
